create_inference_client: create an InferenceClient with an API key and bill_to parameter set to huggingface
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request using InferenceClient with a model and user messages
build_chat_messages: build a list of chat messages with role and content fields for a chat completion call

test_inference_client: test the InferenceClient chat.completions.create method with a simple question
